senses.gloss:
श्च्युत्(इर्)श्च्युतिर् r. 1st cl. (श्च्योतति)
 1. To sprinkle.
 2. To ooze, to drop
or distil.

श्च्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Dropping, flowing.
 2. Shed, sprinkled, issued,
oozed.
 E. श्च्युत् to sprinkle, and क्त aff.

श्च्योत m. (-तः) Sprinkling, pouring forth, aspersion.
 E. श्च्युत् to sprinkle, aff. घञ्; also श्चोत ।

श्च्योतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
 1. Oozing, flowing, trickling.
 2. Shedding. E.
श्च्युत् to ooze, शतृ aff.
